notes: v266 — NAV-MAP-BLANK (owner, Mon Oct 26, 2026 09:20–09:24 MDT, on live v264: the Navigator drive view lost its map — guidance banner, truck and bar alive on an unpitched, unusable view for the whole approach, the PiP window all sky gradient; his 07:40 drive on v259 had rendered tiles). DIAGNOSIS (bisect + render-level harness, tools/nav-map-blank-v266-test.js — the first harness that drives the REAL module on his 768x1024 viewport with a route adopted at 50.969,-114.035 and asserts the composed render: tile layer + native-z18 tile requests, plane coverage by CSS matrix projection, exception-free paint path, inset sign+lanes): the v260 geometry, the OSM native-z18 tiles, the v262 traffic layer and the v264 sign/lane card are all PROVEN GOOD in the same harness (coverage 100.0%, 357 tiles at z18 incl. his tile, EXIT 234B-A + lanes paint, traffic chip + spoken warning fire). The proven breaker is on the paint path itself: fetchLaneCount builds its Overpass query with tp.lat / tp.lng, but pointAlongLine returns a [lat, lng] ARRAY (every other caller indexes [0]/[1]) — building the query throws a TypeError on the first drive tick within 3 km of any turn, and again at every maneuver boundary and 20 s cooldown lapse. The throw is UNGUARDED on driveTick, so each hit aborts the tick BEFORE the inset paint, the traffic chip, the follow pan, the PLANE PAINT and the animator kick (the exact blast radius v227 documented for this call site); at drive-open inside 3 km — his recorded stretch ran 1.2 km → 360 m from the turn — it escapes startDrive itself and the drive opens with the chase transform never painted. The bug is as old as v196 (the lookup has never completed; the suites only ever tested the pure pickers), re-armed by the v220 cooldown rewrite and the v238 query widening. FIX (modules/navigator.js only; no feature removed or altered in behaviour): (1) the query indexes tp[0]/tp[1] — the lane warm-up can complete for the first time; (2) fetchLaneCount is self-guarded (wrapper + run) per its own silent-on-any-failure contract; (3) the tick's trafficOnRoute computation is guarded — a bad incident row costs one tick's chip, never the map; (4) startDrive's opening driveTick and driveOnRoute's driveTick are guarded, so no paint-path fault can abort drive-open or a re-route again. HARNESS: nav-map-blank-v266 37/37 on the fixed tree (fresh drive-open, relaunch-restored route via nav_pending, parked at 0 km/h; transform written on the FIRST tick; coverage 100.0%); run against v259/v260/v262/v264 it reproduces the drive-open throw + never-painted plane on every one. Baselines held EXACTLY (A/B, pre vs post): navigator-test 169/12, navigator-v135 95/0, nav-v260 24/24, nav-traffic-v262 21/21, nav-lane-inset-v264 32/32, nav-lane-info-v238 35/35, nav-lanes-v196 30/30, and every other nav suite at its pre-existing count. Files: modules/navigator.js, tools/nav-map-blank-v266-test.js, index.html (navigator.js cache-bust 264 → 266), version.json. His next drive is the verdict.
